owner_request_2026_11_16_sixth.statement_summary: Ket 27 becomes the only interface and Cascade the only lyrics style; move to 6.0.0, a redesign with big changes; adapt the app to tablets better than Apple Music on iPadOS; keep improving the separation and Ketmix. Then: publish, as 6.0.0 Beta.
owner_request_2026_11_16_sixth.in_this_beta: only the separation work: the redesign (Ket 27 only, Cascade only, tablet layouts) is being built in separate worktrees and is not in this beta

done.hq_model: UVR-MDX-NET Voc FT (sherpa-onnx ONNX export, source SHA-256 e411182c...) converted to LiteRT with float16 weights by publish-stem-model-hq.yml run 43916920223 and published as the ketmix-stems-v2 prerelease (33,429,300 bytes, SHA-256 94f35d9d...); relative difference against the ONNX model 0.0031 on random input
done.uvr_pipeline: stems/Uvr.kt: MixedFft (2^k and 3*2^k), UvrSeparator with sherpa-onnx's chunking (15 s, 1 s margins), 256-frame segments, centred reflect-padded 6144-point STFT; UvrTest replays ONNX Runtime outputs and matches sherpa-onnx's voice at 128 dB on a 20 s MUSDB18-HQ excerpt
done.storage: Separator.maskFromVoice turns the model's voice into the existing 4-bit mono mask on the 4096/1024 grid; StemStore format KVS3 records the model (KVS1/KVS2 still read)
done.choice: ModelPack: two independently downloadable models; ketmixStemsQuality 0 automatic (high quality while charging, quick separations re-done then), 1 always the best, 2 always quick; Automix.prepare looks one title ahead when the slow model runs on battery; a mix waiting for a missing separation uses the quick model when present

measurements.dataset: five MUSDB18-HQ test tracks (60 s excerpts with the most voice), local only, CC BY-NC-SA, not committed
measurements.metric: SDR = 10 log10(|s|^2/|s - s_hat|^2) on the trusted part, median over tracks
measurements.speed: x86 container, LiteRT with 2 threads: about 85 s of computation for 30 s of music (Spleeter: about 3 s); never measured on a phone
